The Bespoke Journey

Crafted to Your
Exact Measure

01

The Consultation

We begin with a private conversation — in-person or via video — where we discuss your vision, the occasion, your body, and your story. No detail is too small.

02

The Fitting

Precision measurements are taken — all 22 of them. Fabric swatches are curated for your approval. A muslin toile is made before we cut the final cloth.

03

The Delivery

Your finished garment is presented in our signature keepsake box, with a care card hand-written by the atelier. It is built to last decades.

Handcrafted Excellence

The Designer

FZ Fashion House Okonkwo

"I design for the African woman who does not need to choose between her heritage and her modernity. She can wear both."

Born in Enugu and trained at the London College of Fashion, FZ Fashion House returned to Nigeria with a singular purpose: to build a couture house that takes African textiles as seriously as any Parisian maison.

Since 2016, her studio in Victoria Island has dressed senators, CEOs, and brides who understand that the best garment you will ever own is the one made for your body and no one else's.

340+ Bespoke Pieces
9 Years in Business
4 Fashion Weeks
